name: Smith Machine Bench Press
cues: Slide the bench so the bar lands on your lower chest
Pin your shoulder blades before you twist the bar off the hooks
Lower with elbows slightly tucked and forearms vertical
Press to straight arms, then turn the bar back onto the hooks
